requirementText: Procurement of 90W outdoor LED street lighting luminaires, CCT 5700K, minimum IP66 ingress protection, surge protection 10kV, LM-79 and LM-80 test reports required, BIS registration under CRS mandatory.
expectedEvidenceRequirements: Clause 5 Construction and Ingress Protection IP66
notes: Verified municipal tender case for street lighting. Must match IS 10322 (Part 5/Sec 3) with CRS compliance mandate.
sourceReference: BIS IS 10322 (Part 5/Sec 3):2012; MeitY Electronics and Information Technology Goods (CRO) 2021
